mapper.sql: select r.review_id, r.owner_user_id, r.review_date, r.mood, r.score, r.conclusion, r.mistake, r.next_plan, r.del_flag, r.create_by, r.create_time, r.update_by, r.update_time, r.remark, (select count(1) from stock_review_trade t where t.review_id = r.review_id and t.owner_user_id = r.owner_user_id and t.del_flag = '0') as trade_count from stock_review r
mapper.select: select t.result_tag from stock_review_trade t inner join stock_review r on r.review_id = t.review_id where t.owner_user_id = #{ownerUserId} and t.del_flag = '0' and r.del_flag = '0' and t.result_tag is not null and t.result_tag != '' and r.review_date >= #{beginDate} and r.review_date <= #{endDate} group by t.result_tag order by count(1) desc, t.result_tag asc limit 1
mapper.update: update stock_review set mood = #{mood}, score = #{score}, conclusion = #{conclusion}, mistake = #{mistake}, next_plan = #{nextPlan}, remark = #{remark}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where review_id = #{reviewId} and owner_user_id = #{ownerUserId} and del_flag = '0'

update stock_review set del_flag = '2', update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where owner_user_id = #{ownerUserId} and del_flag = '0' and review_id in
#{reviewId}
mapper.select: select trade_id, review_id, owner_user_id, stock_code, stock_name, direction, quantity, price, profit_loss, result_tag, note, sort, del_flag, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark from stock_review_trade where review_id = #{reviewId} and owner_user_id = #{ownerUserId} and del_flag = '0' order by sort asc, trade_id asc

select t.trade_id, t.review_id, t.owner_user_id, t.stock_code, t.stock_name, t.direction, t.quantity, t.price, t.profit_loss, t.result_tag, t.note, t.sort, t.del_flag, t.create_by, t.create_time, t.update_by, t.update_time, t.remark from stock_review_trade t where t.owner_user_id = #{ownerUserId} and t.del_flag = '0' and t.review_id = ( select r.review_id from stock_review r where r.owner_user_id = #{ownerUserId} and r.del_flag = '0' and r.review_date < #{beforeDate} and exists ( select 1 from stock_review_trade x where x.review_id = r.review_id and x.owner_user_id = r.owner_user_id and x.del_flag = '0' ) order by r.review_date desc limit 1 ) order by t.sort asc, t.trade_id asc
mapper.update: update stock_review_trade set stock_code = #{stockCode}, stock_name = #{stockName}, direction = #{direction}, quantity = #{quantity}, price = #{price}, profit_loss = #{profitLoss}, result_tag = #{resultTag}, note = #{note}, sort = #{sort}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where trade_id = #{tradeId} and review_id = #{reviewId} and owner_user_id = #{ownerUserId} and del_flag = '0'
